AboutUs.title: About Torlet
AboutUs.intro: Premium fixtures and essentials built to last. We bring quality, reliability, and modern craftsmanship directly to your doorstep.
AboutUs.missionBody: We started Torlet to simplify online shopping for premium home fixtures. No glossy photos hiding poor quality, no vague specifications—just a curated collection of products tested for fit, finish, and long-term performance.

values.val1Body: Dimensions, material grade, and compatibility—every technical specification is thoroughly verified before listing to ensure what you see is what you get.
values.val2Body: Solid brass, vitreous china, and premium finishes. We focus on durable materials that withstand daily use rather than superficial marketing hype.
values.val3Body: Every product comes with transparent coverage guidelines, easy returns, and dedicated support so your purchase is always protected.

ContactUs.title: Contact Torlet
ContactUs.desc: Rough-in question, warranty claim, or a trade order for a whole building, tell us which and we'll route it to someone who knows the fixture, not a ticket queue.

form.name: Name
form.success: Got it, we'll reply within one business day.

reasons.reason1Body: Not sure a toilet's rough-in matches your bathroom? Send the model and a measurement, we'll confirm before you order.
reasons.reason2Body: Something arrived damaged or isn't sealing right? Tell us what happened, we handle the manufacturer claim for you.
reasons.reason3Body: Outfitting multiple units or a full renovation? We quote trade pricing directly, no markup middleman.

Terms.title: Terms & Conditions
Terms.intro: By ordering from Torlet, you're agreeing to the terms below. Read the ones that affect you, returns and warranty are the ones most people actually need.
Terms.questions: Questions about these terms? Reach us at <email>privacy@torlet.com</email>.

sections.s1Body: Placing an order on Torlet means you accept these terms in full. If you don't agree with any part of them, please don't use the site to make a purchase.
sections.s2Body: We do our best to keep specs, dimensions, and rough-in measurements accurate for every fixture listed. Finishes may vary slightly from photos due to screen display or batch variation in materials like ceramic glaze or brass plating.
sections.s3Body: An order is confirmed once payment is successfully processed. We reserve the right to cancel or refuse an order in cases of pricing errors, stock unavailability, or suspected fraud, and will notify you if that happens.
sections.s3List1: Prices are listed in the currency shown at checkout and include applicable taxes unless stated otherwise
sections.s3List2: Bulk and trade pricing is agreed separately and is not covered by standard listing prices
sections.s4Body: Delivery timelines shown at checkout are estimates, not guarantees, and can shift due to courier delays or fixture availability. Risk of loss or damage in transit is covered under our claims process below, not on you as the buyer.
sections.s5Body: Unused fixtures in original packaging can be returned within 14 days of delivery for a refund, minus return shipping. Installed fixtures are covered under the manufacturer's warranty rather than our return policy, contact us and we'll handle the claim on your behalf.
sections.s5List1: Custom or final-sale items are excluded from returns unless defective
sections.s5List2: Damage from improper installation is not covered under warranty
sections.s6Body: You agree not to use the site to commit fraud, resell listings without authorization as your own storefront, or attempt to disrupt or reverse-engineer the site's systems.
sections.s7Body: Torlet's liability for any claim relating to a purchase is limited to the amount paid for that order. We aren't liable for indirect losses, such as costs from a delayed installation, beyond replacing or refunding the fixture itself.
sections.s8Body: We may update these terms as the business changes. Continued use of the site after an update means you accept the revised terms, so check back if you're a returning trade customer.
sections.s9Body: These terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which Torlet is registered, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This describes what we collect when you shop with Torlet, why we collect it, and what say you have over it. Plain terms, no buried clauses.
Privacy.questions: Questions about this policy? Reach us at <email>privacy@torlet.com</email>.

sections.s1Body: We collect information you give us directly, and a smaller set we collect automatically when you use the site.
sections.s1List1: Account details: name, email, phone number, shipping address
sections.s1List2: Order details: items purchased, payment status, delivery preferences
sections.s1List3: Support requests: anything you send us via the contact form or email
sections.s1List4: Usage data: pages viewed, device and browser type, approximate location from IP address
sections.s2Body: We use your information to run the store and keep it useful.
sections.s2List2: Verify warranty and installation support requests
sections.s2List3: Send order updates and, if you opt in, product or promotional emails
sections.s2List4: Improve the site based on how people actually use it
sections.s2List5: Detect and prevent fraud or abuse
sections.s3Body: We don't sell your personal information. We don't share your data with third parties for their own marketing purposes. Fixture manufacturers only receive the details needed to process a warranty claim on your behalf.
sections.s4Body: We use cookies to keep you signed in, remember your cart, and understand which pages get used. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though some parts of checkout may stop working correctly without them.
sections.s5Body: We keep order and account records for as long as your account is active, and for a period afterward as required for tax, warranty, and accounting purposes. You can request deletion of your account data at any time, subject to those legal requirements.
sections.s6List1: Request a copy of the data we hold about you
sections.s6List2: Ask us to correct inaccurate information
sections.s6List3: Ask us to delete your account and associated data
sections.s6List4: Opt out of marketing emails using the unsubscribe link in any email
sections.s7Body: Payment information is processed through our payment provider and is never stored on our own servers in raw form. We use standard encryption in transit and access controls to limit who inside Torlet can view customer data.
sections.s8Body: If we make material changes to how we handle your data, we'll update the date at the top of this page and, for significant changes, notify you by email.
